title: Bridge to Terabithia
description: Jess Aarons and energetic newcomer Leslie Burke create an enchanted imaginary kingdom called Terabithia in the woods. A Newbery Medal-winning exploration of childhood friendship and navigating unexpected grief.

title: Holes
description: Unfairly convicted of stealing sneakers, Stanley Yelnats is sent to Camp Green Lake juvenile detention center, where boys spend all day digging holes in a dried lake bed. An intricate puzzle mystery involving family curses and buried treasure.

title: Charlotte's Web
description: The story of a runt pig named Wilbur and his brilliant barn spider friend Charlotte, who weaves praise into her web to convince the farmer Wilbur is a prize animal. A tender masterpiece about loyalty and life cycles.

title: Matilda
description: Genius bookworm Matilda Wormwood uses her telekinetic abilities and sharp intellect to protect her kind teacher Miss Honey and outwit the tyrannical, child-hurling headmistress Miss Trunchbull.

title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
description: Impoverished Charlie Bucket wins a coveted Golden Ticket granting him and his grandfather Joe a tour of Willy Wonka's fantastical chocolate factory alongside four greedy, spoiled children.

title: The One and Only Ivan
description: Narrated by silverback gorilla Ivan, who has spent twenty-seven years in a glass enclosure at a shopping mall. When a baby elephant arrives, Ivan makes a promise to paint and secure their freedom.

title: A Wrinkle in Time
description: Meg Murry, her precocious brother Charles Wallace, and classmate Calvin O'Keefe travel through a fifth-dimensional tesseract wrinkle in space-time to rescue Meg's physicist father from cosmic darkness.

title: Hatchet
publisher: Simon & Schuster Books for Young Readers
description: After a bush plane crash leaves thirteen-year-old Brian Robeson stranded alone in the Canadian wilderness with only a hatchet, he learns fire-building, foraging, and mental tenacity to survive.

title: The Ultimate Dot-to-Dot Book
description: Dozens of entertaining connect-the-dot puzzles revealing wild animals, vehicles, and festive scenes. Reinforces sequential number counting, hand-eye coordination, and pencil control.

title: My First Learn to Write Workbook
description: Step-by-step tracing exercises for pen control, straight line paths, uppercase and lowercase alphabet letters, and basic sight words designed for preschool and kindergarten learners.

title: Ultimate Sticker Book: Animals
description: Packed with over sixty photographic reusable animal stickers featuring big cats, primates, sea turtles, and polar bears alongside fascinating educational facts and habitat match games.

title: Wipe Clean: First Words
description: A spiral-bound dry-erase activity book allowing children to trace common everyday vocabulary words repeatedly with the included wipe-clean pen, building early handwriting confidence.

title: The Outdoor Art Room
description: Inspiring outdoor sketching, leaf pressing, natural pigment mixing, and pebble painting tutorials that connect young artists with garden exploration and nature journaling.

title: Where's Waldo? The Totally Essential Travel Collection
description: A compact travel-friendly search-and-find compilation containing all seven classic Waldo search adventures with dense, intricately illustrated crowd scenes and hidden bonus checklists.

title: Awesome Science Experiments for Kids
description: Over one hundred safe, hands-on STEM experiments using common kitchen and household ingredients to explore physics, chemical reactions, surface tension, and crystal growing.

title: National Geographic Little Kids First Big Book of Why
description: Bright photographic spreads answering curious questions about why the sky is blue, why tigers have stripes, why we blink, and how puddles evaporate, with simple home activities.

title: Highlights Hidden Pictures Discovery Puzzles
description: Over one hundred black-and-white search-and-find hidden pictures with double duty as detailed coloring pages. Builds sustained visual focus, attention to detail, and patience.

title: The Fault in Our Stars
description: Sixteen-year-old cancer patient Hazel Grace Lancaster meets Augustus Waters at a youth support group. Together they share sharp wit, philosophical conversations, and a pilgrimage to Amsterdam to find a reclusive author.

title: The Hate U Give
description: Sixteen-year-old Starr Carter navigates two worlds: the poor Black neighborhood where she lives and the wealthy suburban prep school she attends. When her unarmed childhood friend is killed by a police officer, Starr's voice becomes a catalyst for community justice.

title: Looking for Alaska
description: Miles Halter leaves his dull life to attend Culver Creek boarding school in search of a "Great Perhaps." There he falls for brilliant, reckless Alaska Young before an unexpected tragedy changes everything.

title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
description: Told through intimate letters to an anonymous recipient, introverted high school freshman Charlie navigates adolescence, mental illness, first love, and family trauma with the help of eccentric senior friends Sam and Patrick.

title: Speak
description: Ostracized by high school classmates after calling the police to break up an end-of-summer party, freshman Melinda Sordino retreats into selective silence. Through an art project, she slowly finds the courage to express what truly occurred that night.

title: One of Us Is Lying
description: Five high school students enter Monday afternoon detention at Bayview High, but only four walk out alive after school gossip creator Simon dies of an allergic reaction. Each survivor had a secret Simon was about to publish.

title: We Were Liars
description: Cadence Sinclair Eastman spends privileged summers on a private Massachusetts island with her cousins and first love Gat, collectively known as The Liars. Following a head injury causing amnesia, Cadence reconstructs the truth of what happened during summer fifteen.

title: Dear Martin
description: High-achieving student Justyce McAllister writes letters in a journal to Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. to process racial profiling and injustice. When an off-duty cop shoots at him and his friend, Justyce finds his life in the national spotlight.

title: All the Bright Places
description: The story of Violet Markey, grieving her sister's death, and Theodore Finch, a boy fascinated by mortality. Partnering on a school geography assignment across Indiana, they find solace and emotional honesty together.

title: Thirteen Reasons Why
description: Clay Jensen receives a package containing seven cassette tapes recorded by classmate Hannah Baker before her suicide, detailing thirteen events and people that drove her decision.

title: Six of Crows
description: Criminal prodigy Kaz Brekker leads a crew of six dangerous outcasts on an impossible heist into the impenetrable Ice Court to rescue a scientist who invented a lethal magic-enhancing drug.

title: Crooked Kingdom
description: Double-crossed after surviving the Ice Court heist, Kaz and the Dregs wage psychological and tactical warfare on the streets of Ketterdam to rescue Inej and dismantle corrupt merchant oligarchs.

title: Shadow and Bone
description: Orphan cartographer Alina Starkov discovers she possesses rare Sun Summoner magic capable of destroying the Shadow Fold dividing Ravka. Brought to court by the enigmatic Darkling, Alina learns royal Grisha court intrigue.

title: The Cruel Prince
publisher: Little, Brown Books for Young Readers
description: Raised in the treacherous High Court of Faerie after her parents are murdered, mortal girl Jude Duarte schemes to claim power despite the cruelty of Faerie royalty, particularly Prince Cardan.

title: The Wicked King
publisher: Little, Brown Books for Young Readers
description: Jude controls High King Cardan through magical oath as senechal of Elfhame, fending off undersea treachery and palace assassinations while their volatile dynamic grows increasingly intimate.

title: The Queen of Nothing
publisher: Little, Brown Books for Young Readers
description: Exiled to the mortal realm, Jude seizes an opportunity to return to Elfhame to save her twin sister Taryn, confronting Madoc and fighting for the crown beside Cardan.

title: Cinder
description: A futuristic sci-fi retelling of Cinderella set in New Beijing where sixteen-year-old cyborg mechanic Cinder gets drawn into planetary politics with Prince Kai while a deadly plague ravages Earth.

title: Scarlet
description: A Little Red Riding Hood reimagining following French farm girl Scarlet Benoit teaming up with street fighter Wolf to find her missing grandmother, intersecting with fugitive cyborg Cinder.

title: Children of Blood and Bone
description: Zélie Adebola fights to restore magic to the land of Orïsha, where a ruthless monarch eradicated the maji. Alongside a rogue princess and her brother, Zélie races to complete an ancient resurrection ritual.

title: An Ember in the Ashes
description: Set in a brutal Roman-inspired Martial Empire, scholar girl Laia goes undercover as a slave at Blackcliff military academy to save her imprisoned brother, crossing paths with elite soldier Elias Veturius.

title: To All the Boys I've Loved Before
series: To All the Boys I've Loved Before
publisher: Simon & Schuster Books for Young Readers
description: Lara Jean Song writes secret letters to the five boys she has ever loved, keeping them in a hatbox. When the letters are secretly mailed out, she enters a fake-dating arrangement with Peter Kavinsky.

title: P.S. I Still Love You
series: To All the Boys I've Loved Before
publisher: Simon & Schuster Books for Young Readers
description: Lara Jean and Peter navigate being in a real relationship until another boy from her past, John Ambrose McClaren, re-enters her life, testing her feelings and commitments.

title: Always and Forever, Lara Jean
series: To All the Boys I've Loved Before
publisher: Simon & Schuster Books for Young Readers
description: High school senior year brings prom, senior trips, and tough university admissions decisions. Lara Jean must weigh staying close to Peter against chasing her dreams at UNC.

title: The Summer I Turned Pretty
publisher: Simon & Schuster Books for Young Readers
description: Belly Conklin spends every summer at Cousins Beach with her mother's best friend's sons, Conrad and Jeremiah. But during summer sixteen, the boys notice her differently, shifting childhood bonds into a love triangle.

title: It's Not Summer Without You
publisher: Simon & Schuster Books for Young Readers
description: Following Susannah's passing, Cousins Beach feels distant until Jeremiah calls saying Conrad has vanished. Belly and Jeremiah embark on a road trip to the summer house to bring him home.

title: We'll Always Have Summer
publisher: Simon & Schuster Books for Young Readers
description: Two years of college lead to an impulsive engagement announcement between Belly and Jeremiah, forcing Conrad to finally confess the feelings he buried.

title: Better Than the Movies
publisher: Simon & Schuster Books for Young Readers
description: Rom-com obsessed Liz Buxbaum recruits obnoxious next-door neighbor Wes Bennett to help her win over her childhood crush Michael for prom, only to find real life outshining cinema romance.

title: Today Tonight Tomorrow
publisher: Simon & Schuster Books for Young Readers
description: High school archrivals Rowan Roth and Neil McNair join forces for a senior class scavenger hunt across Seattle after discovering a conspiracy by underclassmen to target them.

title: Tweet Cute
description: A witty contemporary enemies-to-lovers romance where high schoolers Pepper and Jack unknowingly wage a viral Twitter grilled-cheese war between their families' restaurants while chatting anonymously on an app.

title: Five Feet Apart
authors: Rachael Lippincott; Mikki Daughtry; Tobias Iaconis
publisher: Simon & Schuster Books for Young Readers
description: Cystic fibrosis patients Stella and Will must maintain six feet of distance to avoid cross-infection. As romantic connection deepens, they decide to steal back one foot of distance.

title: A Mind for Numbers
description: Dr. Barbara Oakley explains how to utilize focused and diffuse cognitive thinking modes to master complex technical concepts. The book provides practical study strategies to overcome procrastination and build mathematical intuition.

title: The Joy of x
description: Cornell mathematician Steven Strogatz connects mathematical elegance to daily life, literature, philosophy, and art. Topics range from arithmetic and calculus through prime distributions and topology.

title: How Not to Be Wrong
description: Mathematician Jordan Ellenberg demonstrates that math is an extension of common sense that shields us from faulty statistical assumptions in politics, lotteries, and public policy.
